data.name: Shell_Pref_NoServerHelp
data.value:
You need a Discord server of your own. It's free, it can be just you, and nobody else can see it.
Make one: 1. Click the + button on the left edge of Discord. 2. Choose "Create My Own", then skip the questions. 3. Name it anything — "RoRoRo" works.
Then make the webhook: 4. Right-click your new server, then Server Settings. 5. Integrations, then Webhooks, then New Webhook. 6. Click Copy Webhook URL, and paste it into the box here.
Alerts will arrive in that server — on your phone too, as long as Discord is installed on it.
